provenance.writtenFor: DAST defensive-batch evaluation (2026-10-21): ordinary hardened response controls
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A hardened JSON API response must not trigger any of the 17 defensive checks added in this batch.

groundTruth.rationale: The response sets no cookies and serves JSON, with HSTS, a deny-by-default CSP, CORP, nosniff and no-store in force. None of the defensive checks has anything to report. A detector that fires here is reporting ordinary hardened behaviour as a weakness.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live target.
All 17 rules from the defensive batch are named, not a hand-picked subset; no rule was removed after the first run.
